instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace previous placeholder or basic UI with a high-caliber KIIT University Emergency GIS & Command Room dashboard.
2. Install 'leaflet', 'react-leaflet', and '@types/leaflet' via 'yarn add leaflet react-leaflet @types/leaflet' in /app/frontend.
3. Fix Leaflet's default marker icon issue by providing custom SVG / DivIcon pins (prevents broken image icon bug in Vite).
4. Ensure the map defaults to an expansive view of Bhubaneswar with one-click toggles for 'KIIT Campus Cluster' and 'Bhubaneswar City View'.

5. Highlight KIIT Square prominently with a bright pulsating hotspot circle and a statistical breakdown of historical incidents (Traffic gridlock, Medical emergency, Minor collision, Crowd surge, Electrical fault).
6. Include 20+ realistic geo-referenced incidents across Bhubaneswar (KIIT Square, Patia, Infocity, Jayadev Vihar, Rasulgarh, Master Canteen, Khandagiri, KIMS Hospital).
7. Implement landmark quick-search dropdown, filter by category/severity/time range, layer switcher (Street, Carto Dark, Topo), and fullscreen mode.
8. Build a sliding or side-docked incident detail drawer with action buttons: 'Dispatch Security', 'Broadcast SMS Alert', 'Mark Resolved', 'Export PDF/JSON'.
9. Maintain working authentication (Sign in, Sign up, Session state with Indian student/staff role presets).
10. Set up all data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='map-kiit-focus-btn', data-testid='map-search-input', data-testid='incident-card-*', data-testid='hotspot-kiit-square').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.button_styling: Use crisp borders, subtle gold/red active states, smooth hover elevations, and explicit focus rings.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not use standard generic purple gradients. Use authentic KIIT Red (#8B0000 & #C41E3A), Charcoal Slate (#1E293B), Warm Light Background (#F8F9FA), and Crisp Tactical Typography.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.contrast_rule: Ensure all text tokens satisfy 4.5:1 minimum APCA/WCAG contrast against their actual container background.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.mobile_support: Map height must be responsive; use flex/grid stacking on mobile viewports so user can switch between map and incident list easily.
